questions.q:
Which number in the given series is INCORRECT?
11, 30, 67, 120, 219, 346
questions.s: Pattern check karo: 11, 30, 67, 120, 219, 346. Given answer is 120. Is type ke series questions mein consecutive terms ke differences/pattern ko compare karna useful hota hai.

questions.q:
Which number will come next in the following series?
5, 12, 31, 68, 129, ____
questions.s: Differences dekho: 7, 19, 37, 61. In differences ka pattern 12, 18, 24 se increase hota hai, so next difference 91 hoga. 129 + 91 = 220. Answer: 220.

questions.q:
Identify the number that does NOT belong in the given series.
0, 6, 24, 60, 120, 216
questions.s: Terms ko n(n-1)(n+1) type structure se check karo: 0, 6, 24, 60, 120, 210 hona chahiye. 216 pattern break karta hai. Source answer option C diya gaya hai.

questions.q:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?
7, 14, 33, 70, 131, ?
questions.s: Differences: 7, 19, 37, 61. Difference increments 12, 18, 24 hain, so next increment 30 hoga. Next difference = 91; 131 + 91 = 222. Answer: 222.

questions.q:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?
3, ?, 101, 10202
questions.s: Series ka intended pattern consecutive multiplication/addition based hai. Source mein correct option A, 10 diya gaya hai.

questions.q:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?
2, 4, 16, 52, 132, 282, ?
questions.s: Terms ke differences check karo: 2, 12, 36, 80, 150. Ye differences n^3 - n type growth ko follow karte hain. Next difference 252 aata hai, so 282 + 252 = 534. Answer: 534.

questions.q:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?
20, 10, 10, 15, 30, ?
questions.s: Multipliers pattern: x0.5, x1, x1.5, x2, so next x2.5. Therefore 30 x 2.5 = 75. Answer: 75.

questions.q:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.
11, 14, 31, 14, 16, 34, 17, 18, 37, ?, 20, ?
questions.s: Series ko 3-term groups mein dekho: (11,14,31), (14,16,34), (17,18,37), (?,20,?). First terms +3, second terms +2 and third terms +3. Isse missing values 20 and 40 milte hain. Answer: 20, 40.
